entities.summary: Nikolay Ivanovich Shumakov is a Russian architect, President of the Union of Moscow Architects and President of the Union of Architects of Russia, Chief Architect of the Metrogiprotrans, Academician of the Russian Academy of Arts, Professor of the International Academy of Architecture, Moscow Branch.
